aanvaardings.bewering: Kieme is lewende dinge wat te klein is om te sien. / Selfs broodmuf en kieme is lewende dinge. / (begrip kieme) Baie klein lewende dinge wat 'n mens siek kan maak.
aanvaardings.rede: Whether viruses are alive is not settled by biologists, so 'germs are living things' cannot be proven or disproven for every germ. CAPS Grade 4 treats germs as living things, and we ruled on 19 August 2026 to follow CAPS here and keep the word 'kieme'. Accepted again on 25 November 2026 after HTML-team query N07.
